title_zh: 洞山良价大師 寶鏡三昧歌
title_pinyin: Dòngshān Liángjiè Dàshī Bǎojìng Sānmèi Gē
title_en: Song of the Jewel Mirror Samadhi (Baojing Sanmei)
author_zh: 洞山良价 禪師 (807–869 CE)
author_en: Chan Master Dongshan Liangjie, Co-founder of Caodong (Soto) School

stanzas.zh: 如是之法，佛祖密付。汝今得之，宜善保護。
stanzas.pinyin: Rú shì zhī fǎ, fó zǔ mì fù. Rǔ jīn dé zhī, yí shàn bǎohù.

cleary.text: The Dharma of Thusness is intimately transmitted by Buddhas and Patriarchs. Now that you have obtained it, you should preserve it well.

sasaki.text: The Dharma of Thusness was intimately transmitted by the Buddhas and Ancestors. Now that you have received it, preserve it well.

suzuki.text: The Dharma of Suchness is intimately communicated by Buddhas and Patriarchs; now that you have it, guard it well.

ai_literal.text: Such a dharma as this, Buddhas and Ancestors secretly entrusted. You now having obtained it, ought to skillfully protect it.

stanzas.zh: 銀碗盛雪，明月藏鷺。類之弗齊，混則知處。
stanzas.pinyin: Yín wǎn chéng xuě, míng yuè cáng lù. Lèi zhī fú qí, hùn zé zhī chù.

cleary.text: A silver bowl filled with snow; a bright moon concealing a white heron. Classified, they are not the same; blended, their distinct places are known.

sasaki.text: A silver bowl filled with snow; the bright moon hiding a heron. Resembling each other they are not the same; blended, their distinctive place is known.

suzuki.text: A silver bowl filled with snow, a bright moon concealing a white heron. When you classify them they are not the same; when you blend them you know where each is.

ai_literal.text: A silver bowl holding snow; the bright moon hiding a heron. Categorizing them they are not uniform; mixed together, their location is recognized.

stanzas.zh: 意不在言，來機便赴。動成窠臼，差落顧佇。
stanzas.pinyin: Yì bù zài yán, lái jī biàn fù. Dòng chéng kējiù, chā luò gùzhù.

cleary.text: The meaning is not in words, yet it responds to the arriving impulse. Move and you form a trap; miss and you fall into hesitation.

sasaki.text: The intention is not in words, yet it meets the coming moment. A move creates a rut; a slip falls into hesitating reflection.

ai_literal.text: The meaning lies not in words, meeting the incoming opportunity immediately. Moving creates a rut; erring drops into hesitant gazing.

stanzas.zh: 背觸共忌，如大火聚。但形文彩，即屬染污。
stanzas.pinyin: Bèi chù gòng jì, rú dà huǒ jù. Dàn xíng wéncǎi, jí shǔ rǎnwū.

cleary.text: Turning away and touching are both taboos, like a great mass of fire. To merely portray it with literary embellishment is already defilement.

sasaki.text: Turning away and touching are both to be avoided, like a great fireball. Just to portray it in literary form is already to fall into defilement.

suzuki.text: To turn away and to touch are both wrong, for it is like a great fire. If you only express it with ornate language, you fall into defilement.

ai_literal.text: Turning away and making contact are both avoided, like a great fire heap. Merely shaping literary colors already belongs to defilement.

stanzas.zh: 夜半正明，天曉不露。為物作則，用拔諸苦。
stanzas.pinyin: Yèbàn zhèng míng, tiān xiǎo bù lù. Wèi wù zuò zé, yòng bá zhū kǔ.

cleary.text: At midnight it is truly bright; at daybreak it does not appear. It acts as a standard for all beings, working to pull out all suffering.

sasaki.text: At midnight it is truly luminous; at dawn it does not show itself. Acting as a guide for all beings, its function uproots all suffering.

ai_literal.text: At midnight it is directly clear; at dawn's light it is not exposed. Acting as a standard for things, employed to pluck out all sufferings.

stanzas.zh: 雖非有為，不是無語。如面臨鏡，容色相覷。汝不是渠，渠正是汝。
stanzas.pinyin: Suī fēi yǒu wéi, bù shì wú yǔ. Rú miàn lín jìng, róng sè xiāng qù. Rǔ bù shì qú, qú zhèng shì rǔ.

cleary.text: Although it is not conditioned activity, it is not without words. Like facing a mirror where form and reflection gaze at each other: You are not it, but it is truly you.

sasaki.text: Although it is not fabricated, it is not wordless. Like facing a mirror: form and reflection behold each other. You are not it, but it is truly you.

suzuki.text: Though it is not unconditioned, it is not without words. It is like facing a mirror: form and reflection behold each other. You are not He, but He is you.

ai_literal.text: Though not conditioned action, it is not wordless. Like a face before a mirror, forms and colors looking at each other: You are not Him; He is truly you.
